name: Coarctation of the Aorta

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Coarctation of the Aorta

criteria.description: Elevated blood pressure in upper extremities compared to lower extremities
Delayed or diminished femoral pulses compared to brachial pulses
Imaging confirmation of aortic narrowing via echocardiography, MRI, or CT angiography
Presence of a systolic murmur heard best over the back or left infrascapular area
Evidence of left ventricular hypertrophy on ECG or imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of upper limb hypertension and brachial-femoral pulse delay with imaging confirmation of aortic narrowing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging studies; blood pressure discrepancies are key diagnostic clues.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Coarctation of the descending aortic arch
Abnormal left ventricular outflow tract morphology

laboratory: Elevated serum brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiography showing aortic narrowing and left ventricular hypertrophy
MRI or CT angiography demonstrating discrete aortic coarctation
Chest X-ray showing rib notching due to collateral circulation
genetic: Association with Turner syndrome (45,X) and other chromosomal abnormalities
NOTCH1 gene mutations reported in some familial cases
other: Blood pressure gradient >20 mmHg between upper and lower limbs
Collateral vessel formation visible on imaging

distinguishingFeatures: Inflammatory arterial wall thickening on imaging
Systemic symptoms like fever and malaise
Long segment narrowing of the abdominal or thoracic aorta
Different anatomical location compared to typical coarctation

redFlags: Severe hypertension refractory to medical treatment
Signs of heart failure in infancy
Neurological symptoms suggestive of intracranial hemorrhage
references: Maron BJ, et al. Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Present and Future, J Am Coll Cardiol. 2014.
Mullins CE, et al. Coarctation of the Aorta: Diagnosis and Management, Circulation. 2019.
Orphanet: Coarctation of the Aorta, ORPHA:1457
